description: Resynthesiser: one or two incoming signals are analysed into frequency bands, and up to 36 oscillators are driven from the strongest of those bands

params.text: Picks the waveform every oscillator uses: sine, triangle, sawtooth, square or a rectangle a quarter of a cycle wide
Sets how many oscillators are driven, 1 to 36
Sets the balance between the two inputs added together and the resynthesis, 0 to 100% resynthesised
Scales the frequency of every oscillator, doubling it at +1 and quadrupling it at +3, halving it at -1.5 and falling to 20Hz at -3, which is not the octave scaling the tooltip names
Sets how far each oscillator is pushed away from the warp centre frequency, 0 to 100%, which at 100% doubles its distance from that centre
Sets the frequency the warp pushes the oscillators away from, 0Hz to 10000Hz
Adds the frequency of the first voice to the warp centre, so the centre follows the analysed fundamental and CENTER becomes an offset from it
Makes the AM/RM matrix ring-modulate the oscillators against one another rather than against the AM/RM inputs, and turns the mix grid into a blend between an oscillator and that ring modulation
Offsets which band's level drives each oscillator, -35 to 35 voices, so one frequency is made loud or quiet by another
Picks how the strongest bands are handed to the oscillators: normal, inverted magnitude, reverse, or reverse with inverted magnitude
Adds an offset to every value on the MORPHING grid, -100% to 100% of its range, moving every oscillator between the first input and the second
Adds an offset to every value on the FM AMOUNT grid, 0 to 100% of its range
Adds an offset to every value on the AM/RM MIX grid, 0 to 100% of its range
Sets the middle of the part of the spectrum searched for the strongest bands, 0 to 100%
Sets how wide a part of the spectrum is searched for the strongest bands, 0 to 100%, where 100% reaches everything
Sets how much of the output is added back into both analysis inputs, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: The first signal to be analysed and resynthesised
The second signal to be analysed, which the MORPHING grid blends against the first
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the FM MATRIX grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the FM MATRIX drawing across the oscillators, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the FM AMOUNT grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the FM AMOUNT drawing across the oscillators, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
A frequency modulation source for whichever oscillators the FM MATRIX assigns to it; polyphonic, and 5V shifts an oscillator by 10000Hz
A second frequency modulation source for whichever oscillators the FM MATRIX assigns to it; polyphonic, and 5V shifts an oscillator by 10000Hz
A modulator for whichever oscillators the AM/RM MATRIX assigns to it; polyphonic
A second modulator for whichever oscillators the AM/RM MATRIX assigns to it; polyphonic
Adds to the voice count, 10V covering 1 to 36 oscillators
Adds to the waveform, 10V stepping across all five
Adds to the frequency scaling, 10V covering the whole -3 to 3 range
Adds to the warp amount, 10V covering 0 to 100%
Adds to the warp centre frequency, 10V covering 0Hz to 10000Hz
Adds to the mix, 10V covering dry to fully resynthesised
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the AM/RM MATRIX grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the AM/RM MATRIX drawing across the oscillators, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the AM/RM MIX grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the AM/RM MIX drawing across the oscillators, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds to the voice shift, 10V covering -35 to 35 voices
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the MORPHING grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the MORPHING drawing across the oscillators, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the PANNING grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the PANNING drawing across the oscillators, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds to the spectral mode, 10V stepping across all four
Adds to the analysis centre, 10V covering the whole spectrum
Adds to the analysis bandwidth, 10V covering 0 to 100%
Adds to the feedback, 10V covering 0 to 100%

outputs.text: The left channel of the result, carrying the whole unpanned mix while the right output is unpatched
The right channel of the result

notes: a grid is drawn on by dragging across it, and holding shift while dragging keeps the drag on the band it started on, so one band can be set without disturbing its neighbours
each grid is one display rather than one control per band, so no band can be clicked for a line of its own
right-clicking a grid opens that grid's own menu rather than the module's, and All Maximum, All Minimum, All Half, Triangle, Sine, Ramp and Random fill the grid with that shape
a grid's own right-click menu also carries Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical, Reduce By Half, Shift Left and Shift Right, which rework what is already drawn on it
menu: # of Frequency Bands for In 1 — sets the analysis of the first input to 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096 bands; small frames follow transients, large ones read pitch better
# of Frequency Bands for In 2 — sets the analysis of the second input to 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096 bands; small frames follow transients, large ones read pitch better
Window Function — picks the shape each frame is multiplied by before analysis: None, Triangle, Welch, Sine, Hanning, Blackman, Nutall or Kaiser
